title: Bitwise OR of Adjacent Elements
description:
Given an array nums of length n , return an array answer of length n - 1 such that answer[i] = nums[i] | nums[i + 1] where | is the bitwise OR operation. 

 Example 1: 

 Input: nums = [1,3,7,15] 
 
 Output: [3,7,15] 

 Example 2: 

 Input: nums = [8,4,2] 
 
 Output: [12,6] 

 Example 3: 

 Input: nums = [5,4,9,11] 
 
 Output: [5,13,11] 

 Constraints: 

 2 <= nums.length <= 100 
 
 0 <= nums[i] <= 100
approach_summary: Use XOR, bit masks, bit positions, or binary representation.
